## About
Shark Tank Poker Club is Central Ohio's original poker room, right on Bethel Road in Columbus. We want the room to feel fun, friendly, safe and inviting, whether you play big stakes or you're sitting down for the first time.
We run daily tournaments, marquee tournaments and satellites, and you can join the waitlist or check the tournament clock before you head over. Players have given us a 4.7 rating from 215 Google reviews.

## Services
- Daily tournaments: Tournaments run every day, along with marquee events and satellites.
- Texas Hold'em and Omaha: One reviewer mentioned both games are played here.
- Waitlist and tournament clock: Join the waitlist for a seat or view the tournament clock to see where things stand.

## FAQ
Q: I'm new to poker. Is this a good place to start?
A: Yes. The room is meant to be inviting to all skill levels, and one first-time visitor said the volunteers were helpful and friendly.

Q: How do I get a seat?
A: Join the waitlist. You can also view the tournament clock there.
